fusions.name: Known Weak Spot
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy up to 4 tiles away, which deals 16 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Held by the Stare
fusions.desc: Fixes everything in a cone 5 tiles long with a stare, which deals 10 damage, stuns them for 1.2 seconds and leaves them [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Reading the Gait
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured Regard
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
